# David Meerman Scott

> The professional platform of bestselling author and marketing strategist David Meerman Scott, featuring books, speaking services, coaching, and insights on fan engagement and real-time marketing.

David Meerman Scott is an internationally recognized marketing speaker and author of twelve published books translated into 29 languages. His work focuses on converting fans into customers, real-time marketing strategies, and modern approaches to marketing and PR.

## Key Topics

- Real-time marketing
- Fanocracy
- Fan engagement
- Newsjacking
- Marketing strategy
- Customer loyalty
- Content marketing
- Social media marketing
- The Fandom Playbook
- The New Rules of Marketing and PR
- Marketing the Moon
- Marketing Lessons from the Grateful Dead
- Digital marketing
- Keynote speaking
- Business growth

## Core Services

- [Marketing Speaker](https://www.davidmeermanscott.com/marketing-speaker): International marketing speaker services covering real-time marketing and agile selling
- [Coaching](https://www.davidmeermanscott.com/coaching): Coaching and advisory services for marketing strategy and business growth
- [Speaking Events Calendar](https://www.davidmeermanscott.com/events-calendar): Calendar of upcoming speaking engagements and keynote events
- [Speaker Reviews](https://www.davidmeermanscott.com/marketing-speaker-reviews): Client testimonials and rave reviews from speaking engagements

## Published Books

- [The New Rules of Marketing and PR](https://www.davidmeermanscott.com/books/the-new-rules-of-marketing-and-pr): Bestselling marketing and PR guide in 6th edition, translated into 29 languages
- [The Fandom Playbook](https://www.davidmeermanscott.com/books/the-fandom-playbook): Strategic guide on building human connection in a world of digital chaos
- [Fanocracy](https://www.davidmeermanscott.com/books/fanocracy): Book on fan engagement and customer loyalty strategies
- [Marketing Lessons from the Grateful Dead](https://www.davidmeermanscott.com/books/marketing-lessons-from-the-grateful-dead): Marketing strategy lessons from the Grateful Dead's fan engagement model
- [Marketing The Moon](https://www.davidmeermanscott.com/books/marketing-the-moon): Apollo 11 and NASA's historic marketing and PR campaign
- [All Books](https://www.davidmeermanscott.com/books): Portfolio of David Meerman Scott's twelve published books
